notes.title: Offline mode, logo positioning, Windows 11 testing, rare crash on opening fixed
notes.content:
[h3]Offline Mode[/h3]

Imagine you're at a show, but you've forgotten your steam login details. Or there's no internet, but you were logged out of Steam, so Steam's offline mode doesn't work...

Worries no more! AI VJ has its own offline mode now! If there's no internet, or you've closed the Steam login widget, AI VJ will now start anyway! So your show can go on! WIth peace of mind. Be sure to make the 'Desktop Shortcut for Offline Use' from the Main Menu, before leaving home, as otherwise you'll have to find the '.exe' file manually (usually in Program Files x86/ Steam/ steamapps/ common/ AI-VJ/ AI-VJ.exe).

When there is internet, AI VJ will try to go through Steam first, as it's better for updates, and you staying up to date with the latest. But in a pinch our new offline mode allows you to use AI VJ for 50 hours of runtime between logins on Steam. That should last you a festival. Unless you don't sleep or eat at all! :D (thanks Habbening and others for requesting this feature)

[h3]Logo Positioning[/h3]

The Small Logos, and the Flash Banner, now have a 'Position' menu item (under 'Logos'), that allows you to position them at the top instead of bottom. Nice to change things up, or when your projector is partially hidden behind a table or stage (thanks Habbening).

[h3]Bugs Fixed[/h3]

I finally got access to a Windows 11 development machine, and have been thoroughly testing AI VJ. Everything worked as expected, though I did manage to track down one bug. In the meantime we also updated to the latest Unity version, and we're now using the latest video libraries as well.

Bugs fixed:
- Somewhat rare crash on opening AI VJ that would happen when loading a really old save file, or when no visuals files referenced from the save were left in place

If you reported (other) bugs, we're keeping a list and working through them! Please keep reports coming!

[h3]Join us on Discord![/h3]

Feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]our Discord[/url]!

notes.title: More bugs fixed! Some tricky ones. Drag & drop polished, test coverage...
notes.content:
This is a smaller update than the previous in terms of what directly changes for you in the app's behaviour.

But we've been hard at work tracking down and fixing some of the more tricky bugs, adding more tests, and future-proofing our visuals production toolchain.

[h3]Bugs fixed[/h3]

First what will directly improve for you; the bugs we fixed:

- Banks; when dragged and dropped on Banks would always move to the bottom position on the Deck. No more. This one was unpleasant.

- Items dropped on a Bank handle, now go into the Bank, just like with Decks

- A rare bug causing a crash when deleting the last Bank in a Deck, while having 3 Sets; Fixed!

- Replacing a Deck when hovering over, instead of selecting, didn't work. Now it does work

- Using the Keyboard shortcut to create a new Deck didn't work. Now it does

- When the Messages "side-app" is open, the newest message now subtly flashes

If you reported (other) bugs, we're keeping a list and working through them! Please keep reports coming!

[h3]Automated Tests[/h3]

Most of these bugs we found, and tracked down thanks to our new automated tests. We've got 60 of them now. Having the computer tests the app saves a lot of time over doing it manually (in literally a minute, what would take a day manually), and ensures it's done consistently before every release. Avoiding the re-appearance of earlier bugs.

We started adding tests because of a bad bug some weeks back that affected only new installs. Which we, nor our Discord community of longer-term users ran into for days, as ...well..., we already had it installed. We fixed it within 2 days, but it was one of these never again moments. Thus the new install scenario is covered by an automated test now.

Most of our other tests so far cover drag & drop, and keyboard control. We'll keep adding to our tests as we work on things. It will be a while - alongside our normal development - before near full test coverage is here. But we aim to make AI VJ as bug-free as can be!

We've also got something in the works with regards to visuals. But more on that later.

[h3]Join us on Discord![/h3]

Feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]our Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Bugs fixed! Message counter, automated tests, color contrast, replace banks!
notes.content:
Several bugs and suggestions for improvement were reported in [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]our Discord[/url], and by others over the last weeks. We've implemented most of them!

[h3]Automated Tests![/h3]

One particularly bad bug affected new installs, and caused the app to crash. We've not had one of these since launch. Luckily M_E_G_A_S_XLR pointed it out. We fixed it and released a quick intermediate update within two days.

But in order to avoid bugs like this from showing up again (especially of situations which I myself as an user don't come across), and as the code-base grows, it's become time to add automated tests to make sure this never happens again!

For now we've added tests for core features that if they were to fail would make the app unusable, but we've also begun adding them for most other functionality. It will be months - alongside our normal development - before near full test coverage is here. But we aim to make AI VJ as bug-free as can be!

[h3]Improvements[/h3]

In this update we've improved the app in many small ways:

- Activated buttons now have a green background. Hopefully this should make them being pressed a lot clearer now (requested by Habbening and Anne)

- Deck-tabs now have a separate top part indicating whether a deck is selected. This was unclear before when there was a conflict between the dark-blue color of the open deck would override the selection color (suggested by Anne)

- Installed and non-installed DLCs are now in separate sub-menus to limit issues with extra wide monitors (non 16 x 9 ratio; HD & 4k are fine) hiding them from view (thanks to Pug for reporting).

- We've got a FAQ (Frequently Asked Questions) now. You'll [url=https://ai-vj.com/faq.html]find it here[/url]! (thanks bigolchungo)

- Global Shuffle mode added (requested by Habbening). It shuffle plays visuals between all banks and decks of the active set. It's functionally equivalent to setting Shuffle Fract to 0 and enabling shuffle on all banks and decks.

It's a handy shortcut for when you want maximum variety, instead of the default consistency of style and themes, that comes with shuffling within a bank, before moving on to another bank, and later, deck.

- When dropping items and banks to the right of the set tabs at the top, new sets are now created around them. Seemed most consistent, as it already did for decks.

- The messenger button now has a small green number listing the number of un-viewed messages. Just like some phone apps!

- When locking drag & drop, you now get a message

Cosmetic ones:
- 'Add New Bank' button a bit smaller now (Anne)
- More consistent padding for different settings windows
- Menu split lines now have some indentation
- All menu items Now in Capital Case
- Banks and Decks now have a rounded left corner

[h3]Bugs fixed[/h3]

- Rare bug causing a crash when closing the last deck of a set while having 3 or more sets

- From the 'Visuals' menu, Replace All Banks didn't remove the old ones. Fixed!

- Logo DLC: Closing the last deck when editing Logos and the Flash banner is now prevented

- Banks could in rare cases 'get stuck' between 2 others when dragging and dropping. Now fixed!

- Tooltips of deck tab buttons referred to banks instead of decks. Fixed!

- The space bar would hide the UI, even when editing a bank name, or other text field. Fixed

If you reported other bugs, we're keeping a list and working through them! Please keep reports coming!

[h3]Join us on Discord![/h3]

Feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]our Discord[/url]!

notes.title: Copy-Paste, Undo-Redo & History List, Edit Menu, Keyboard Shortcuts, and More!
notes.content:
On the community forums, copy-paste, and hotkeys were requested by xburcali. They're here now, plus undo-redo to go back on changes, and more!

[h3]A New Edit Menu![/h3]

We now have a fully loaded Edit menu for moving visuals, banks and other things around!

You can undo and redo with Ctrl-Z & Y, and in the Edit menu there's a Undo History list as well, to make larger jumps in your edit history.

Then there's copy, cut, and paste, as well as replace, duplicate and new. Hotkeys are listed in the Edit menu for easy reference.

Other things such as saving, and opening saves can now also be accessed via hotkeys!

This should bring us even closer to our aim of having the best User Interface in the VJ world!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046679/20ddfba8f6f9b57040154097562a44a7238409f5.png[/img]

[h3]New Input System[/h3]

To manage all of these shortcuts while keeping things neat, we've swapped in a new input system. This should make it easier in the future to add support for key customization, and even midi controllers! Though that will be a later update.

[h3]Millisecond precise video switches![/h3]

We've revisited the video playback logic, and optimized it to make video transitions even faster and more precisely timed.

[h3]And Several Smaller Fixes[/h3]

- Increased the size of the mouse cursor a little. Good for those wild nights...

- Dragging and dropping near the bottom of a near empty deck works now

- Things like single decks drag-dropped to the right of the last set now are pasted more intuitively, creating a new set. Preveiously they were just added to the last deck. Same for banks in decks

If you reported other bugs, we're keeping a list and working through them! Please keep reports coming!

[h3]Join us on Discord![/h3]

Feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]our discord[/url]!

notes.title: Saving and loading Sets, better performance, logo unpause bug, and more fixes!
notes.content:
A new saving & loading Sets feature, and several reported bugs fixed!

[h3]Sets can now be saved and loaded!:[/h3]

It is now possible to save Sets separate from the whole Mixer (which includes all sets and logos)

This per Set saving is handy if you wish to keep multiple sets for different event types, or move Sets or Decks from one setup to another

Or if you own the Logo DLC, if you've made changes to the logo of one Mixer setup, but now wish to use & copy over some Sets you made earlier in another save

[h3]Performance has improved!:[/h3]

Players for media such as videos, images and shaders are now only initialized when the relevant content is added to a Set, or Deck, or Bank in a Set.

For most setups this means loading less than half the players loaded previously, and thus much faster startup times, and better performance on slower & memory-limited machines! (requested by Anne)

[h3]And lots and lots of smaller fixes:[/h3]

- A very intricate bug that caused logos not to show after unpausing, was fixed!

- "Restore Default Set" from the Main menu works again

- Default save locations now work properly

- Playback now automatically restarts after loading a Mixer or Set

notes.title: The Decks and Sets update!; accessible via tabs; all drag & droppable + more!
notes.content:
The big update: Decks and Sets are here, for organizing and accessing more visuals with ease!

And two feature requests were fulfilled, and several reported bugs fixed!

[h3]Decks and Sets have arrived!:[/h3]

Decks are what's currently a whole screen of banks with visuals, and sets are a collection of decks.

These can now be accessed through tabs at the top of the screen, moved around through drag & drop, and played whole. Giving you many more levels of control over your VJ show!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046679/2acc65c6b4a9a4a5a7428fb62e78eb2f213cbcb9.png[/img]

You can now import DLCs as a whole deck, and thus more easily switch between them during a show. 

And a whole set of decks can even play in shuffle-mode so while providing coherent style / thematic blocks of visuals, the whole thing can still run hands-free!

Oh and you can drop visuals or whole banks on decks, and even move decks between sets, or even whole sets by simply dragging and dropping. The kind of easy control that makes creativity flow naturally!

Another feature added are duplicate buttons for decks and banks. They make it easier to create multiple versions of your favorite decks or banks, without having to re-import them (requested by Habbening).

[h3]Logo DLC: now multiple DJ logos!:[/h3]

- For those with the Customize Your DJ Logo DLC: It is now possible to have multiple DJ logos, and switch between them (feature request by Habbening).

Every deck added to the Flash Banner, Small Logo, or Big Logo sets now can be selected from the Logos menu to be the one activated when the logo buttons are pressed / enabled.

Handy when there's a line-up of multiple DJs for the night!

[h3]And a lot of smaller fixes:[/h3]

- An overhaul of the playback selection code. Much less complex now thanks to some state keeping in sets, decks, and banks themselves, and thus easier to build upon, and less prone to hangups now.

- Fixed a bug that caused the app to crash if all visuals were removed from logos (Logo DLC, reported by u_space). Also fixed a similar issue when all visuals were removed from the main banks.

- If somehow all logos get deleted, it will now automatically restore them, and in the worst case of the save file missing / being corrupted, restore to the default decks & logos

- Now hides notices if the settings section is open

- Dozens of smaller fixes

This update was in the making for months, and has been the biggest since release. We hope no major bugs were introduced with it. And we ran it for hours to make sure it's reliable. But there's always a chance. Please report bugs on our Discord!

Note that due to an overhaul of some of the naming, it might be necessary to run a "Restore Default Set and Logos" before everything works as expected, especially with regards to sample visuals & logos.

[h3]Join us on Discord!:[/h3]

Feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]our discord[/url]!

notes.title: Logo DLC now supports video, no more banner, menu overhaul + bug fixes
notes.content:
Three feature requests fulfilled this week, and several reported bugs fixed!

[h3]Logo DLC video logos!:[/h3]

- For those with the Customize Your DJ Logo DLC: Videos can now be loaded onto the logo decks, and will play just like image logos (feature request by Habbening).

They're shown transparently on top of any visuals playing at 50% alpha for now. In a later update you'll be able to adjust this, & we'll also be adding support for logos of multiple DJs.

[h3]No more banner!:[/h3]

- For everyone: The AI VJ banner that appears once every 20 minutes can now be disabled from the DJ Logos menu! 

Previously requiring the Logo DLC for this was something that seemed to make business sense, but didn't sit quite right with me. A review by DarkSeraph made me reconsider & drop that requirement.

So now AI VJ is fully usable as a free VJ app.

The Logo DLC for logos & adding your own banners is something we keep though.

Logo buttons are a 'nice to have' convenience feature that even Resolume (at € 299) doesn't have as such, and that any performing DJ (with a logo) should easily be able to afford after using AI VJ without a logo (or with a logo loaded onto a visuals Bank) for a night.

Also note that income from DLCs goes directly towards development; AI VJ so far is still mostly a labour of love that I'm using for my own shows, rather than something that's making me a living wage.

Adding support for logo videos was good preparation for adding layer support for all visuals, in a future update. We'll have to finish some other updates first before this can happen.

Yet with this update we're moving (allbeit slowly, and with a small step) towards our aim of becoming the easiest to use (free) VJ app!

[h3]And a lot of smaller fixes:[/h3]

- An overhaul of the menu (feature request / report by Anne).

The menu needed updating for the new Unity version, and in the process we have improved consistency, and visual effects such as the tick-marks with selected settings, and making the sub-menu arrows point in the right (left) direction.

- A bug that occasionally caused switching between full-screen & windowed mode to be unreliable was nipped. Having to dive into the ancient Windows DLLs that deal with this again was not pretty. But it should work more consistently now.

- A bug with the logos & AI VJ banner having an unwanted line at the top has been fixed. As well as a bug making grey squares sometimes appear, and a rare bug in the frequency of the appearance of the banner when enabled & its ordering with regard to the logos.

- The fractals appearing too small at first play for 6 seconds on certain screen setups now no longer happens.

- Spout output settings are now saved with the settings.

notes.title: Memory leak found & fixed! No more crashes!
notes.content:
The occasional issue with crashes has been fixed!

AI VJ would sometimes keep remnants of visuals in the PCs working memory for much longer than needed. This then would balloon its memory usage, sometimes even slowing down other software on the same machine, and eventually cause a crash of AI VJ.

It didn't normally show up for me as my setup has a lot of memory. But particularly on a machine with 8gb or less, it could show up in less than 2 hours with the 4k visuals, one user reported!

It was really tricky to pin down and fix. As leaked memory is memory not tracked by the code for cleanup. But this exact thing makes it hard to find where it's happening too! Turned out to be in the video player library we use; which has now been fixed!

[h3]Join us on Discord!:[/h3]

Feature requests & bug reports are welcome. And please do report bugs, as we had no idea of the potential scale of this issue for quite a while.

Please report bugs either here or come to [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]our discord[/url] for a chat!

Oh, and the amazing Real 1 Visuals will be released later this week!

[h3]For this update we have a feature requests fulfilled, and several more things added:[/h3]

- You can now connect AI VJ to other software through Spout:
[list]
[*] So if you wish to steam with AI VJ in the backgrount, you can!
[*] Or if you'd like to do post-processing in Resolume, and apply effects, you can!
[/list]

Moreover Spout is super efficient, and the industry standard way to do this! (Thanks deverostv for the request!).

In the future we plan to add various music synced effects and shaders. AI VJ is being developed in Unity after all! But while other updates are happening, and in general, Spout is a nice way to add spice to the visuals, for those who own Resolume or other VJ software!

- We've added [url=https://ai-vj.com/usage_tutorials.html#spout]a tutorial setting out how to use Spout[/url], as well as for using your own VJ videos / loops and images in AI VJ, and other things, such as working with a projector or external display

- Besides all this, there is now also an 'open folder' option for every DLC in the menu, in case you'd want to import the videos into other VJ software directly. Though be aware of [url=https://ai-vj.com/software_and_visuals_license.html]the license conditions[/url]

- To support Spout we had to switch to Unity's High Definition Render Pipeline. This means AI VJ is now optimized for high quality output, using the latest GPU features!

Especially handy for said effects, shaders, and future 3D animations that we are planning, eventhough these are still mid to low on the roadmap. It did require a fair number of color, and other backend changes. Though these were eventually needed anyway!

Next up on the roadmap is an expansion of the UI, to allow multiple tabbed decks with banks, and then visuals. So it will be easier to organize visuals, and add Steam Workshop support in the future.

Support for videos of any native BPM has been added! So whether they are 128, 80, or even 150 BPM loops, AI VJ can now sync up all of your own videos too!

Also know that AI VJ already supports videos at any common resolution, which are automatically displayed maximized. So you should be good to go with any VJ loops as long as the aspect ratio works on the screen you're using it on!

With these features AI VJ has - as far as I am aware - become the most easy to use VJ software in its price range!

To celebrate this, and Rhythm Fest which is now happening on Steam, we've discounted many of our DLCs for the week!

[h3]For this update we have 4 feature requests fulfilled, and several more things added:[/h3]

- As mentioned, support for videos of any BPM: Say after [url=https://vimeo.com/223765005]downloading a loop here[/url], you can import it by clicking the folder icon on a new bank. Then open settings in the right side panel, and select the video(s) for which you wish to adjust the BPM and set it, say to 128 for the example video. Playback will be updated live! (thanks George and others for the request!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45046679/6a6d6780eec9467adaa85c8112aa1bf96d0a4933.png[/img]

Note that all our videos so far are 120 BPM, in case you changed it for a video and wonder what to reset it to again.

- It is now possible to switch Banks by using just keyboard shortcuts. The numbers 1-9 (to 0 for 10 really) will play the corresponding bank! Note that this only works while the window is in focus. Being able to remap them, and other features such as MIDI control will come at some point too, but you'll need some patience for those (thanks Hazard6s!).

- Imported videos are now muted. Allowing you to use even videos & loops that already have music with them, without their audio disrupting your music! (thanks Hrochoslon!)

- And finally a particularly bad bug in the window / resizing code was fixed. It made the buttons not work on high resolution screens. Now all fixed! (thanks for reporting it Ron!).

Please do report any remaining bugs in our discord, no matter how small!

Smaller fixes included in this update are:
- Fractal shaders from the default deck were not screen filling on some larger screens, or when the projector & UI screen differed in resolution. Now they are generated at the largest of the required sizes!
- The taskbar remained visible on full screen for the UI. Now hidden
- There were issues with the size of the resize buttons when moving from vertical to horizontal screen layouts. Now they stay the same size
- The logo that replaces the window control buttons in windowed mode now links to [url=https://ai-vj.com/]AI-VJ.com[/url]

[h3]Join us on Discord!:[/h3]

Other feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]our discord[/url]!

notes.title: Update: Moveable windows, Unity 6, license & tutorials
notes.content:
This update seemed simple. Supporting windowed mode for display 2...

Well, Unity basically doesn't support multi display setups. I mean you can open them.

But if you want to have them windowed as opposed to fullscreen, or to have a UI on the second display, forget it. It couldn't even translate mouse positions to click buttons on display 2 correctly.

Well luckily; not quite forget it...

After updating to Unity 6 for minor improvements on this front, I went around Unity, and addressed windows DLLs directly to get it done. A week later, I know more than I'd ever wanted about how Windows does its window business. Down to repositioning borderless windows, and calculating, scaling and correcting mouse positions so they are translated to window space.

Anyway I'm not letting anything get in the way of your user experience!

[h3]For this update we again have 2 feature requests fulfilled!:[/h3]

- First is the aforementioned moveable windows. You can now set them to windowed, and drag them around. AI VJ even remembers whether you preferred them full-screen or windowed. Saving their position may be added later if you want it (thanks Moinvibes and Piotr!)

- The second feature request fulfilled is a license for the use of the visuals and software. In short AI VJ can be used for any kind of performance, and visuals can be used to create music videos and streams! This license, as well as the tutorials are now linked from the main menu (thanks maplesyrupghost).

- Finally we've upgraded to Unity 6. Which means some optimizations, and that we're ready for the future. As while not perfect, Unity does many things well!

I've tested the app several times. But be in touch if there's any bugs!

[h3]Join us on Discord!:[/h3]

Other feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or on [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]our discord[/url]!

notes.title: Update: Nudge adjust, tapping BPM, and chill slow mode!
notes.content:
From now on updates will be mostly done during the first half of the week

For people with a gig or party on the weekend being notified of an update just before going live in front of an audience is not ideal. Even if updates were always to be bug-free. While Friday updates were pleasant for me for the excitement of sharing an improved AI VJ, from now most will be between Monday and Wednesday, about every other week.

[h3]For this update we have 2 feature requests fulfilled, and several more things added:[/h3]

- Nudging the visuals timing to an adjustable number of milliseconds before, or after the predicted beat is now possible! So on a wide range of hardware you can get the timing exactly right! Especially recommended with Ableton Link Sync to get that last bit of precision (thanks Henk and Moinvibes for the request!)

- Manually tapping the beat is now another way to let AI VJ know what the BPM is. This is how dedicated VJs have been doing it for decades. And now AI VJ can also work with their routines (thanks Henk!)

- In addition the tapped BPM can also be fed as a hint to the Audio Sync, and then be aligned with audio onsets for a more dynamic approach where you can correct the Audio Sync

- A slow mode has been added for calmer nights at home. Just click the cute little snail!

- A full screen button has been added to the UI. So hiding the UI for operation on a single screen is immediately accessible!

And we've applied a host of smaller fixes:
- updated splash screen
- some spelling fixes
- issue with empty notices fixed

notes.title: Update: Loop mode, audio auto-detect, and better button icon animations!
notes.content:
After a cheerful launch that uncovered no show stopping bugs, our first regular update is here!

Quality of life improvements, and 2 fulfilled feature requests!:

- Banks of visuals can now be set in loop mode. This means that when played, only visuals from that bank will be played / cycled. It won't jump to the next. Handy for that special song, or for the picture slide-show at a private event! (thanks djm.s.n for requesting it [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]in our discord[/url]!)

- Audio devices are now automatically detected on start for new installs, and everyone who hasn't manually selected anything else. This makes starting the app sufficient to start the party!

- We've subtly improved our buttons. With different images & not just different colors, for pressed & unpressed states, it should be much clearer now which button is pressed and which isn't. And with the backdrop shadows, they should stand out a little better against light videos

- In full screen mode we've added a close window X in the top right corner! Added a windowed mode button as well. Easy for getting to the desktop, or closing things up after a grand show! (thanks Filip!)

And we've applied a host of smaller fixes:
- reduced the time it takes for tooltips to show
- added notices about state of the art real time BPM detection being 75% correct at best
- when audio falls silent for over 5 seconds, it now returns to 120bpm instead of going wild
- dealth with a crash that sometimes happens on exit
- updated a link from the menu

Requests for feedback:

Note that banks set to loopmode will be skipped when playing other banks in global shuffle mode. This to avoid the shuffle from getting stuck in their loops

Also it makes sense as looping banks tend to be used for special content, which you'd not want to show up in shuffle play anyway

This seems to be the most logical way to implement this. Let us know if you think differently

Other feature requests & bug reports are welcome. Either here or [url=https://discord.gg/DQZHJyDebC]in our discord[/url]!
